The '''FSD-6D flying surveillance droid''' was a small, gray, spherical [[Camera/Legends|camera]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], covered in [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], commonly used by the early [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was equipped by a 1-meter lens-tipped extensible stalk, allowing it to look round corners. Able to see in low light and into the [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] spectrum, it came with a claw appendage, a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], a [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processor]], locked access, an integrated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Sensor/Legends|sensor units]], an improved sensor package, and a [[Holorecorder/Legends|video recording unit]]. A single droid cost 19,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
